newsitem.title: JAMAICA: CRICKET-LAXMAN MAKES 98 AS INDIA HEAD FOR DRAW.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-LAXMAN MAKES 98 AS INDIA HEAD FOR DRAW.

text.p: Opener Vangipurappu Laxman was run out for 98 on Sunday as India headed for a stalemate in the opening match of their West Indies tour against Jamaica.
India, replying to Jamaica's first innings 453 for nine wickets declared, reached 271 for five at the end of the third day of a four day match with Rahul Dravid hitting a stylish 86.

Jamaica fast bowler Franklyn Rose took the other three wickets to fall on Sunday with a performance that may have earned him a place in the West Indies team for the first test starting in Kingston on Thursday.
Rose, who is uncapped, claimed the scalps of India's top batsmen, captain Sachin Tendulkar and Mohammad Azharuddin, in a superb ten over spell with the second new ball.

India resumed at 66 for one with Laxman and Dravid both making slow progress to start with before throwing away their caution. They added 178 for the second wicket before the elegant Dravid was bowled by Rose.
Tendulkar faced just ten balls before being bowled off the inside edge for six, while Laxman's innings ended when he was run out attempting an impossible single to leave India 222 for four.
India added two more runs before Azharuddin was out for one, hitting a simple return catch to Rose. Left-hander Saurav Ganguly, on 45, and wicket-keeper Nayan Mognia, 15, were not out at the close.
